title: Harden monetization gateway defaults
body:
## Summary
- Disables the API Gateway `demo-key` by default and only permits it with `ALLOW_DEMO_KEY=1` outside production.
- Adds production startup gates for restricted CORS and configured keystore/API keys.
- Adds billing checkout/subscription metadata so webhook provisioning can map paid plans reliably.
- Adds tests for gateway security defaults and records pytest/pytest-mock test dependencies.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human
- [ ] Red: In production, set `ENV=production`, `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, and either `USE_KEYSTORE=1` or explicit `API_KEYS` before deploying.
- [ ] Yellow: Run a test Stripe checkout/webhook and verify the provisioned key receives the correct pro/team/enterprise plan.
- [ ] Yellow: Confirm local demo behavior only works when `ALLOW_DEMO_KEY=1` is explicitly set.

### Notes
Tested with:
- `python3 -m compileall -q src/services/api_gateway/main.py src/services/billing/main.py tests/services/api_gateway/test_gateway_security_defaults.py`
- `python3 -m pytest tests/services/api_gateway/test_gateway_security_defaults.py tests/services/billing/test_billing.py`
